JPMorgan, American Express and Travelers Are Raising Dividends for Retirees
summary: Three Dow financials pay yields under 2%, yet retirees keep piling in. Their secret is a payout that eats barely a quarter of earnings, and one of them has already survived a brutal cut that should give income seekers pause.
